name: Unlinked Provider Begins Registration
summary: The user completes the Microsoft provider ceremony as the representative supported-provider permutation; the validated subject is unlinked and no canonical durable user exists, so the server creates an OAuth-external PendingIdentity and the client opens Complete Profile without trusting provider email as ownership proof.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous, the provider subject is unlinked, and duplicate lookup finds no durable user

serverInteraction.intent: Validate the external-provider assertion, begin exactly one oauth-external PendingIdentity, preserve provider email only as asserted evidence, and route the ceremony to profile completion.

postconditions.expression: a ceremony-only OAuth-external PendingIdentity exists; no durable user or normal application session exists

sourceReferences.note: Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
